sources.note: Main corporate site. ModMed offers all-in-one specialty EHR, practice management, RCM, AI, and patient engagement solutions.
ONC certification / mandatory disclosures page for ModMed ASC. Page content was mostly JS/CSS — limited readable disclosure content.

ASC product page. Describes ASC software connecting EHR, practice management, scheduling, charting, and billing. Mentions concurrent charting, anesthesia/nursing auto-population, vital signs/imaging interfacing, ASCQR compliance.
Ophthalmology ASC page. Purpose-built for ophthalmic surgery centers with EHR, billing, surgical scheduling, real-time reporting.
GI ASC page. All-in-one GI ASC solution with EHR, scheduling, billing, endoscopy tools, and reporting.

Empire Surgery Center ophthalmology case study. Replaced paper-based operative reports and nursing docs. Customizable surgical forms, time-stamped signatures, direct messaging, faxing, QA reports, compliance reporting. Manages pre/intra/post-op notes, anesthesia docs, discharge records.

Tri-County GI case study. gGastro ERW enables 3-minute procedure notes. Intelligent prompting for follow-up intervals. Integration with gPortal for patient chart access. Instant report delivery to referring physicians.

GI ASC blog post. Details ERW generating procedure notes/discharge summaries/letters. PM handles professional, office, ASC, and facility billing. Analytics for quality metrics, efficiency, compliance, referrals. Patient engagement via kiosks, portals, reminders. Cloud-based real-time sync across facilities.
Solutions overview. Confirms ModMed offers specialty-specific EHR, practice management, analytics, and patient engagement as modular ecosystem.
Practice management page. Described as hub for admin tasks including medical billing and reporting. Limited detail in rendered content.

Software Finder profile. 4.3/5 rating from 442 reviews. Features: AI-powered docs, iPad charting, integrated PM, scheduling, billing, RCM, e-prescribing, coding support. 12+ specialties including ASCs. Positive on workflow efficiency; negative on system stability and support.

EHR in Practice profile for EMA. AI-powered specialty EHR with appointment mgmt, billing, clinical workflow, EM coding, insurance/claims, lab integration, patient history, portal, reporting, scheduling, voice recognition, e-prescribing. ModMed Scribe trained on 750M encounters.
Clearlake Capital completed majority investment in ModMed April 2025. Previously backed by Warburg Pincus for ~8 years.
LeadIQ company profile. Reports ~1,949 employees, 40,000+ providers served.
Patient portal page. Patients access diagnoses, visit notes, handouts, test results, request refills, send encrypted messages.
Lab Connect page. EMA EHR exchanges electronic lab orders and results with physician network.
